scope: current-PC only; Python 3 and host GTK dependencies required

media.setup: Install yt-dlp and FFmpeg on PATH; dictation works without media.

formatting.setup: Install llama.cpp llama-server on PATH, then select/download the verified S1-mini model in Settings. Raw remains the default.

clipboard_wayland.setup: Install wl-clipboard for Wayland clipboard delivery.

typing_wayland.setup: Install wtype if supported by the compositor; Copy Last remains available.

ask_keys.setup: Install libsecret tools and enable a session Secret Service, then configure an optional Ask provider key in Settings.

rich_ask.setup: Install the complete WebKitGTK 6 package for this distribution, including subprocess helpers and resources. Restart Koett. Plain Ask remains available without it; sandbox stays enabled.
